title: Master of Accounts

purpose.en: The chart of accounts (COA). Open it to add a new general ledger account, change an existing one, or switch one on or off. Every journal, voucher and invoice posts to an account listed here.
purpose.id: Daftar akun (COA). Buka layar ini untuk menambah akun buku besar baru, mengubah akun yang ada, atau mengaktifkan dan menonaktifkannya. Semua jurnal, voucher, dan invoice diposting ke akun yang ada di sini.

keywords: coa, chart of accounts, account, gl account, kode akun, daftar akun, akun, bagan akun, master akun, rekening, cost center, normal balance, saldo normal, postable

steps.en: Open Master of Accounts. Type a code or name in the search box to find an account, or use the Type, Level and Postable filters.
steps.id: Buka Master of Accounts. Ketik kode atau nama di kotak cari untuk menemukan akun, atau pakai filter Type, Level, dan Postable.

steps.en: Click + New Record to add an account. To change one, open its row.
steps.id: Klik + New Record untuk menambah akun. Untuk mengubah akun, buka barisnya.

steps.en: Pick the Parent Account (leave empty for a top-level account), then fill Account Code, Account Name, Type and Normal Balance.
steps.id: Pilih Parent Account (kosongkan bila akun paling atas), lalu isi Account Code, Account Name, Type, dan Normal Balance.

steps.en: Set the optional Default Cost Center and Tax Scheme. Tick the checkboxes that apply: reconciliation account, can be journaled directly, and Active.
steps.id: Isi Default Cost Center dan Tax Scheme bila perlu. Centang kotak yang sesuai: akun rekonsiliasi, bisa dijurnal langsung, dan Active.

steps.en: Click Save. The new account is numbered by the system and appears in the list in code order.
steps.id: Klik Save. Akun baru diberi nomor oleh sistem dan tampil di daftar urut menurut kode.

steps.en: To switch an account off (or on again), use the activate toggle on its row and confirm. Header accounts cannot be edited or toggled here.
steps.id: Untuk menonaktifkan akun (atau mengaktifkannya lagi), pakai tombol aktif/nonaktif pada barisnya lalu konfirmasi. Akun header tidak bisa diedit atau diubah statusnya di sini.

fields.label: Parent Account
fields.en: Pick the group (header) account this account sits under. Leave empty for a top-level account. An account cannot be its own parent. The Level column in the list follows from this.
fields.id: Pilih akun grup (header) tempat akun ini berada. Kosongkan bila akun paling atas. Akun tidak boleh menjadi parent dirinya sendiri. Kolom Level di daftar mengikuti pilihan ini.

fields.label: Account Code
fields.en: The GL code, up to 20 characters, for example 115100. Typed by you and must be unique. The internal account number is created by the system.
fields.id: Kode akun buku besar, maksimal 20 karakter, misalnya 115100. Diketik sendiri dan harus unik. Nomor internal akun dibuat otomatis oleh sistem.

fields.label: Account Name
fields.en: The name shown on journals, ledgers and reports, up to 150 characters, for example Warehouse Petty Cash.
fields.id: Nama akun yang tampil di jurnal, buku besar, dan laporan, maksimal 150 karakter, misalnya Kas Kecil Gudang.

fields.label: Type
fields.en: The account class: Asset, Liability, Equity, Revenue, COGS, Expense, Other income or Other expense. Reports group balances by this class.
fields.id: Kelas akun: Asset, Liability, Equity, Revenue, COGS, Expense, Other income, atau Other expense. Laporan mengelompokkan saldo menurut kelas ini.

fields.label: Normal Balance
fields.en: DEBIT or CREDIT: the side on which the account normally increases. Assets and expenses are normally debit; liabilities, equity and revenue are normally credit.
fields.id: DEBIT atau CREDIT: sisi tempat saldo akun normalnya bertambah. Aset dan beban biasanya debit; kewajiban, ekuitas, dan pendapatan biasanya kredit.

fields.label: Default Cost Center
fields.en: Optional. Pick the cost center proposed for this account, from the active cost centers. Shown in the Default Cost Center column.
fields.id: Opsional. Pilih cost center yang diusulkan untuk akun ini, dari cost center yang aktif. Tampil di kolom Default Cost Center.

fields.label: Tax Scheme
fields.en: Optional reference code such as PPN_IN, PPN_OUT, PPH22 or PPH23, up to 20 characters. It holds no rate; the percentage is read from the tax scheme master when a voucher is posted.
fields.id: Kode acuan opsional seperti PPN_IN, PPN_OUT, PPH22, atau PPH23, maksimal 20 karakter. Tidak menyimpan tarif; persentasenya dibaca dari master skema pajak saat voucher diposting.

fields.label: Reconciliation account (requires a partner on every journal line - AR/AP)
fields.en: Tick for control accounts of receivables or payables. Every journal line on such an account must name a partner. These accounts are refused in manual journals.
fields.id: Centang untuk akun kontrol piutang atau hutang. Setiap baris jurnal pada akun ini wajib menyebut partner. Akun ini ditolak di jurnal manual.

fields.label: Can be journaled directly
fields.en: Tick for accounts that receive postings (Postable = Yes). Untick for header or group accounts, which only sum their children and are shown as Header in the list.
fields.id: Centang untuk akun yang menerima posting (Postable = Yes). Hilangkan centang untuk akun header atau grup, yang hanya menjumlah akun di bawahnya dan tampil sebagai Header di daftar.

fields.label: Active
fields.en: Untick to stop using the account without deleting it. Inactive accounts are marked in the list.
fields.id: Hilangkan centang untuk berhenti memakai akun tanpa menghapusnya. Akun nonaktif diberi tanda di daftar.

title: Journal Entries

purpose.en: Create and process manual journals made by Accounting: manual, accrual, recurring, adjustment and opening balance. Open it to prepare a journal, send it for approval, post it to the General Ledger, or reverse a posted one.
purpose.id: Membuat dan memproses jurnal manual dari bagian Accounting: manual, akrual, berulang, penyesuaian, dan saldo awal. Buka untuk menyiapkan jurnal, mengajukan persetujuan, memposting ke General Ledger, atau membalik jurnal yang sudah diposting.

keywords: jurnal, journal, jurnal umum, jurnal manual, accrual, akrual, adjustment, penyesuaian, recurring, opening balance, saldo awal, reversing, jurnal pembalik, debit, kredit, gl, general ledger, posting

steps.en: Open Journal Entries and click + New Record. Fill Description, Journal type, Transaction date and, if you have one, the Reference number.
steps.id: Buka Journal Entries lalu klik + New Record. Isi Description, Journal type, Transaction date, dan Reference number bila ada.

steps.en: Fill the lines: pick the Account, enter an amount in Debit or Credit (not both on one line), and optionally a Cost center and Narration. Add more lines as needed.
steps.id: Isi baris jurnal: pilih Account, isi Debit atau Credit (jangan keduanya pada satu baris), dan bila perlu Cost center serta Narration. Tambah baris sesuai kebutuhan.

steps.en: Check the totals under the lines. The journal can only be saved when Debit equals Credit and is not zero; the tag then shows Balanced.
steps.id: Cek total di bawah baris. Jurnal hanya bisa disimpan bila Debit sama dengan Credit dan tidak nol; tanda akan berubah menjadi Balanced.

steps.en: Click Save to keep it as Draft, or Submit for Approval to save it and send it to the approver (status Pending approval).
steps.id: Klik Save untuk menyimpan sebagai Draft, atau Submit for Approval untuk menyimpan sekaligus mengirim ke penyetuju (status Pending approval).

steps.en: The approver opens the journal and clicks Approve, or Return to Draft to send it back. A person who prepared the journal cannot approve it when segregation of duties applies.
steps.id: Penyetuju membuka jurnal lalu klik Approve, atau Return to Draft untuk mengembalikan. Pembuat jurnal tidak boleh menyetujui jurnalnya sendiri bila aturan pemisahan tugas berlaku.

steps.en: Click Post to GL on an Approved journal. It becomes Posted and appears in General Ledger and Trial Balance. Posting into a closed period is refused.
steps.id: Klik Post to GL pada jurnal yang Approved. Statusnya menjadi Posted dan muncul di General Ledger dan Trial Balance. Posting ke periode yang sudah ditutup ditolak.

steps.en: A Posted journal is never edited. To correct it, click Reverse, enter the Reversal date and Reason, and click Post Reversal; then enter a corrected journal.
steps.id: Jurnal yang sudah Posted tidak pernah diedit. Untuk mengoreksi, klik Reverse, isi Reversal date dan Reason, lalu klik Post Reversal; setelah itu buat jurnal pengganti yang benar.

fields.label: Description
fields.en: What the journal is for, up to 255 characters, for example Office utilities accrual. Required.
fields.id: Tujuan jurnal, maksimal 255 karakter, misalnya Akrual listrik kantor. Wajib diisi.

fields.label: Journal type
fields.en: Manual Journal, Accrual Journal, Recurring Journal, Adjustment Journal or Opening Balance. Reversing Journal and Year-end Closing are created by the system, not chosen here.
fields.id: Manual Journal, Accrual Journal, Recurring Journal, Adjustment Journal, atau Opening Balance. Reversing Journal dan Year-end Closing dibuat oleh sistem, tidak dipilih di sini.

fields.label: Transaction date
fields.en: The date of the journal. It sets the accounting period it posts to.
fields.id: Tanggal jurnal. Tanggal ini menentukan periode akuntansi tempat jurnal diposting.

fields.label: Reference number
fields.en: Optional supporting document number, for example REF-2026-0001. Shown in the Reference column and in General Ledger.
fields.id: Nomor dokumen pendukung, opsional, misalnya REF-2026-0001. Tampil di kolom Reference dan di General Ledger.

fields.label: Auto-reverse date
fields.en: Only for Accrual Journal. The date the system posts the reversing journal by itself. It must be after the Transaction date.
fields.id: Hanya untuk Accrual Journal. Tanggal sistem memposting jurnal pembalik secara otomatis. Harus setelah Transaction date.

fields.label: Account
fields.en: Pick a postable account from the chart of accounts. Receivable, payable and advance control accounts are refused; those go through Order to Cash and Procure to Pay.
fields.id: Pilih akun yang bisa diposting dari daftar akun. Akun kontrol piutang, hutang, dan uang muka ditolak; itu lewat Order to Cash dan Procure to Pay.

fields.label: Debit
fields.en: Amount on the debit side of this line, in Rupiah. Leave empty when the line is a credit.
fields.id: Nilai sisi debit baris ini, dalam Rupiah. Kosongkan bila baris ini kredit.

fields.label: Credit
fields.en: Amount on the credit side of this line, in Rupiah. Leave empty when the line is a debit. Total Credit must equal total Debit.
fields.id: Nilai sisi kredit baris ini, dalam Rupiah. Kosongkan bila baris ini debit. Total Credit harus sama dengan total Debit.

fields.label: Cost center
fields.en: Optional. The cost center this line belongs to, from the active cost centers.
fields.id: Opsional. Cost center tempat baris ini dibebankan, dari cost center yang aktif.

fields.label: Narration
fields.en: Optional note for this line. It is shown in the journal lines and in General Ledger.
fields.id: Catatan opsional untuk baris ini. Tampil di rincian jurnal dan di General Ledger.

fields.label: Reversal date
fields.en: In the Reverse window: the date of the reversing journal. Debit and credit are swapped in full into a new Posted journal; the original stays as the audit trail.
fields.id: Di jendela Reverse: tanggal jurnal pembalik. Debit dan kredit dibalik penuh ke jurnal baru berstatus Posted; jurnal asal tetap ada sebagai jejak audit.

fields.label: Reason
fields.en: In the Reverse window: why the journal is reversed, up to 120 characters, for example wrong cost center. Required.
fields.id: Di jendela Reverse: alasan jurnal dibalik, maksimal 120 karakter, misalnya salah cost center. Wajib diisi.

title: Cashier (Cash & Bank)

purpose.en: Record cash and bank vouchers: cash receipt (BKM), cash payment (BKK), bank receipt (BBM) and bank payment (BBK). Open it to enter a voucher as Draft, then post it to the ledger.
purpose.id: Mencatat bukti kas dan bank: bukti kas masuk (BKM), kas keluar (BKK), bank masuk (BBM), dan bank keluar (BBK). Buka untuk mengisi voucher sebagai Draft, lalu memostingnya ke buku besar.

keywords: kas, bank, cash, voucher, bkm, bkk, bbm, bbk, bukti kas masuk, bukti kas keluar, bukti bank, cashier, kasir, penerimaan, pembayaran, giro, cek, ppn, pph, e-faktur, bukti potong

steps.en: Open Cashier (Cash & Bank) and click + New Record.
steps.id: Buka Cashier (Cash & Bank) lalu klik + New Record.

steps.en: Choose the Transaction Type, the Posting Date and the Main Cash/Bank Account, then the Partner / Recipient and the Reference / Check No. / Giro.
steps.id: Pilih Transaction Type, Posting Date, dan Main Cash/Bank Account, lalu isi Partner / Recipient dan Reference / Check No. / Giro.

steps.en: In Journal Detail, the first line is filled with the main account. Add the other side: pick the Account, a Description and the amount, using Add Journal Line for more lines.
steps.id: Di Journal Detail, baris pertama otomatis berisi akun utama. Isi sisi lawannya: pilih Account, Description, dan nilainya, pakai Add Journal Line untuk baris tambahan.

steps.en: If the voucher has VAT or withholding tax, open the Tax Information tab and fill it in.
steps.id: Bila voucher memuat PPN atau pemotongan PPh, buka tab Tax Information lalu isi.

steps.en: Click Save Draft. The system gives the voucher a number in the form type/year/month/sequence, for example BKM/2026/10/001.
steps.id: Klik Save Draft. Sistem memberi nomor voucher dengan pola jenis/tahun/bulan/urut, misalnya BKM/2026/10/001.

steps.en: Check that Total Debit equals Total Credit (Variance is zero), then click Post Journal and confirm. A posted voucher can no longer be edited.
steps.id: Pastikan Total Debit sama dengan Total Credit (Variance nol), lalu klik Post Journal dan konfirmasi. Voucher yang sudah diposting tidak bisa diedit lagi.

steps.en: To drop a Draft you no longer need, open it and click Cancel and confirm; its status becomes Cancelled.
steps.id: Untuk membuang Draft yang tidak dipakai, buka draft itu lalu klik Cancel dan konfirmasi; statusnya menjadi Cancelled.

fields.label: Document No.
fields.en: Filled by the system when you save. Cannot be typed.
fields.id: Diisi otomatis oleh sistem saat disimpan. Tidak bisa diketik.

fields.label: Transaction Type
fields.en: Cash Receipt Voucher (BKM), Cash Payment Voucher (BKK), Bank Receipt Voucher (BBM) or Bank Payment Voucher (BBK). It decides the journal book (cash or bank) and the direction of the first line.
fields.id: Cash Receipt Voucher (BKM), Cash Payment Voucher (BKK), Bank Receipt Voucher (BBM), atau Bank Payment Voucher (BBK). Menentukan buku jurnal (kas atau bank) dan arah baris pertama.

fields.label: Posting Date
fields.en: The accounting date of the voucher. It sets the period it posts to. Required.
fields.id: Tanggal pembukuan voucher. Menentukan periode tempat voucher diposting. Wajib diisi.

fields.label: Main Cash/Bank Account
fields.en: The cash or bank account the money moves through, chosen from the cash and bank accounts (codes starting 111). Required. Shown in the Cash / Bank Account column.
fields.id: Akun kas atau bank tempat uang keluar atau masuk, dipilih dari akun kas dan bank (kode berawalan 111). Wajib diisi. Tampil di kolom Cash / Bank Account.

fields.label: Partner / Recipient
fields.en: Typed name of the company or person paying or receiving the money. Shown under the voucher number in the list.
fields.id: Nama perusahaan atau orang yang membayar atau menerima uang, diketik sendiri. Tampil di bawah nomor voucher pada daftar.

fields.label: Reference / Check No. / Giro
fields.en: Optional reference such as a cheque or giro number.
fields.id: Referensi opsional seperti nomor cek atau giro.

fields.label: Account Code & Name (COA)
fields.en: On each journal line, pick a postable account from the chart of accounts. At least one line with an account and an amount is required.
fields.id: Pada tiap baris jurnal, pilih akun yang bisa diposting dari daftar akun. Minimal satu baris dengan akun dan nilai wajib ada.

fields.label: Description
fields.en: Optional note for the journal line.
fields.id: Catatan opsional untuk baris jurnal.

fields.label: Debit (IDR)
fields.en: Debit amount of the line, in Rupiah. For a receipt (BKM, BBM) the main account line is on the debit side.
fields.id: Nilai debit baris, dalam Rupiah. Untuk penerimaan (BKM, BBM), baris akun utama ada di sisi debit.

fields.label: Credit (IDR)
fields.en: Credit amount of the line, in Rupiah. For a payment (BKK, BBK) the main account line is on the credit side. Total Credit must equal Total Debit before posting.
fields.id: Nilai kredit baris, dalam Rupiah. Untuk pembayaran (BKK, BBK), baris akun utama ada di sisi kredit. Total Credit harus sama dengan Total Debit sebelum diposting.

fields.label: VAT Treatment
fields.en: Non-VAT, Input VAT 11% or Output VAT 11%. Tax Information tab.
fields.id: Non-VAT, Input VAT 11%, atau Output VAT 11%. Ada di tab Tax Information.

fields.label: Tax Invoice Number (e-Faktur)
fields.en: The e-Faktur tax invoice number when VAT applies, for example 010.003-25.00000000.
fields.id: Nomor faktur pajak e-Faktur bila ada PPN, misalnya 010.003-25.00000000.

fields.label: Withholding Tax Type
fields.en: No Withholding Tax, Income Tax Art. 23 (2% - Services), Art. 4(2) (10% - Rent/Building) or Art. 21 (Non-Employee).
fields.id: No Withholding Tax, Income Tax Art. 23 (2% - Services), Art. 4(2) (10% - Rent/Building), atau Art. 21 (Non-Employee).

fields.label: Withholding Tax Slip Number
fields.en: The withholding tax slip (bukti potong) number, for example BP-2025-0001928.
fields.id: Nomor bukti potong PPh, misalnya BP-2025-0001928.

title: Procure to Pay

purpose.en: Supplier bills and their payment. Open it to record a bill received from a supplier, approve and post it, pay it, and check input VAT and withholding tax.
purpose.id: Tagihan supplier dan pembayarannya. Buka untuk mencatat tagihan dari supplier, menyetujui dan memostingnya, membayarnya, serta memeriksa PPN masukan dan pemotongan PPh.

keywords: hutang, payable, ap, tagihan supplier, vendor bill, bill, invoice supplier, bayar, pembayaran supplier, p2p, procure to pay, ppn masukan, pph 23, pph 22, faktur pajak, gr/ir, spb, jatuh tempo

steps.en: Open Procure to Pay. Search, filter by Supplier or Status, or use the stat boxes (Draft, Open, Overdue, Paid) to find bills.
steps.id: Buka Procure to Pay. Cari, saring menurut Supplier atau Status, atau pakai kotak statistik (Draft, Open, Overdue, Paid) untuk menemukan tagihan.

steps.en: Click + New Record. Search and pick the Vendor, enter the Vendor bill number, and pick the Goods receipt (PV) if the bill is for received goods.
steps.id: Klik + New Record. Cari dan pilih Vendor, isi Vendor bill number, dan pilih Goods receipt (PV) bila tagihan untuk barang yang sudah diterima.

steps.en: Fill Description, Bill date, Due date, the Debit account and the Net amount (IDR). Choose the Withholding tax and tick Tax code for Input PPN when they apply.
steps.id: Isi Description, Bill date, Due date, Debit account, dan Net amount (IDR). Pilih Withholding tax dan centang Tax code untuk PPN Masukan bila berlaku.

steps.en: Click Save for a Draft, or Approve & Post. A bill at or above the approval limit goes to Pending approval instead of posting.
steps.id: Klik Save untuk Draft, atau Approve & Post. Tagihan yang mencapai batas persetujuan masuk ke Pending approval dan belum diposting.

steps.en: An authorized approver opens the bill and clicks Approve & Post. The person who recorded the bill cannot approve it when segregation of duties applies.
steps.id: Penyetuju yang berwenang membuka tagihan lalu klik Approve & Post. Pencatat tagihan tidak boleh menyetujui tagihannya sendiri bila aturan pemisahan tugas berlaku.

steps.en: To pay, open a posted bill and click Pay Bill. Set the Payment date, Pay from and a note, type the amount to pay per bill, then click Post Payment.
steps.id: Untuk membayar, buka tagihan yang sudah diposting lalu klik Pay Bill. Atur Payment date, Pay from, dan catatan, isi nilai bayar per tagihan, lalu klik Post Payment.

steps.en: Input VAT shows a warning mark until the tax invoice is validated; use Validate tax invoice in the row menu of the older register page.
steps.id: PPN masukan diberi tanda peringatan sampai faktur pajak divalidasi; pakai Validate tax invoice di menu baris pada halaman register lama.

fields.label: Vendor
fields.en: Type at least 2 letters of the supplier name or code and pick from active suppliers. A subcontract supplier proposes PPh 23, and the Due date follows the supplier's payment term. Required.
fields.id: Ketik minimal 2 huruf nama atau kode supplier lalu pilih dari supplier aktif. Supplier subkontrak mengusulkan PPh 23, dan Due date mengikuti syarat bayar supplier. Wajib diisi.

fields.label: Vendor bill number
fields.en: The invoice number printed on the supplier's bill, up to 50 characters. Required. Shown in the list instead of the internal number.
fields.id: Nomor invoice yang tercetak di tagihan supplier, maksimal 50 karakter. Wajib diisi. Tampil di daftar menggantikan nomor internal.

fields.label: Goods receipt (PV)
fields.en: Optional. Pick a goods receipt of this supplier so the bill clears GR/IR (three-way match with the PO). Leave empty for services or expenses.
fields.id: Opsional. Pilih penerimaan barang supplier ini agar tagihan melunasi GR/IR (pencocokan tiga arah dengan PO). Kosongkan untuk jasa atau biaya.

fields.label: Description
fields.en: What the bill is for, up to 255 characters, for example Kertas Ivory 310 gsm - Sept. Required.
fields.id: Untuk apa tagihan ini, maksimal 255 karakter, misalnya Kertas Ivory 310 gsm - September. Wajib diisi.

fields.label: Bill date
fields.en: The bill and posting date. It must fall in an open accounting period.
fields.id: Tanggal tagihan sekaligus tanggal posting. Harus jatuh di periode akuntansi yang masih terbuka.

fields.label: Due date
fields.en: The date payment is due. Cannot be before the Bill date. Due this week and Overdue are counted from it.
fields.id: Tanggal jatuh tempo pembayaran. Tidak boleh sebelum Bill date. Status Due this week dan Overdue dihitung dari tanggal ini.

fields.label: Debit account
fields.en: The account debited by the bill: GR/IR Clearing 211900 (default) for received goods, or an inventory, asset or expense account. Required.
fields.id: Akun yang didebit oleh tagihan: GR/IR Clearing 211900 (bawaan) untuk barang yang sudah diterima, atau akun persediaan, aset, atau biaya. Wajib diisi.

fields.label: Net amount (IDR)
fields.en: The bill amount before VAT, in Rupiah, at least 1. Required.
fields.id: Nilai tagihan sebelum PPN, dalam Rupiah, minimal 1. Wajib diisi.

fields.label: Withholding tax
fields.en: None, PPh 23 (services, 2%) or PPh 22 (1.5%). The withheld amount is kept as a payable and shown in the bill amounts.
fields.id: None, PPh 23 (jasa, 2%), atau PPh 22 (1,5%). Nilai yang dipotong dicatat sebagai hutang pajak dan tampil di nilai tagihan.

fields.label: Tax code
fields.en: Tick to add Input PPN (PPN Masukan); the amount is shown as you type. Untick for a bill without VAT.
fields.id: Centang untuk menambah PPN Masukan; nilainya tampil saat Anda mengetik. Hilangkan centang untuk tagihan tanpa PPN.

fields.label: No. Faktur Pajak (e-Faktur)
fields.en: The supplier's tax invoice number. Leave empty when it has not been received yet.
fields.id: Nomor faktur pajak dari supplier. Kosongkan bila belum diterima.

fields.label: Payment date
fields.en: In the Payment Run window: the date of the payment. Required.
fields.id: Di jendela Payment Run: tanggal pembayaran. Wajib diisi.

fields.label: Pay from
fields.en: In the Payment Run window: the cash or bank account the payment is taken from. Required.
fields.id: Di jendela Payment Run: akun kas atau bank sumber pembayaran. Wajib diisi.

fields.label: Note / transfer reference
fields.en: In the Payment Run window: optional transfer reference, for example TRF-009821.
fields.id: Di jendela Payment Run: referensi transfer, opsional, misalnya TRF-009821.

fields.label: Pay
fields.en: In the Payment Run window: the amount paid to each open bill of the supplier. The chosen bill starts with its full balance. Posting is Dr Payable / Cr Bank.
fields.id: Di jendela Payment Run: nilai yang dibayarkan ke tiap tagihan terbuka milik supplier. Tagihan yang dipilih terisi sebesar sisanya. Jurnalnya Dr Hutang / Cr Bank.

fields.label: Status
fields.en: List column, read-only: Draft, Pending approval, Open, Partially paid, Due this week, Overdue, Paid or Cancelled.
fields.id: Kolom daftar, hanya baca: Draft, Pending approval, Open, Partially paid, Due this week, Overdue, Paid, atau Cancelled.

title: Fixed Assets

purpose.en: The register of fixed assets such as machines and vehicles, with their depreciation. Open it to register a new asset, capitalize it, run monthly depreciation, view the depreciation schedule, or dispose of an asset.
purpose.id: Daftar aset tetap seperti mesin dan kendaraan, beserta penyusutannya. Buka untuk mendaftarkan aset baru, mengkapitalisasinya, menjalankan penyusutan bulanan, melihat jadwal penyusutan, atau melepas aset.

keywords: aset tetap, fixed asset, asset, penyusutan, depreciation, kapitalisasi, capitalize, mesin, kendaraan, nilai buku, net book value, nbv, garis lurus, saldo menurun, pelepasan, dispose, jual aset

steps.en: Open Fixed Assets. Filter by Category or Status, or use the stat boxes (Draft, Active, Fully depreciated, Disposed).
steps.id: Buka Fixed Assets. Saring menurut Category atau Status, atau pakai kotak statistik (Draft, Active, Fully depreciated, Disposed).

steps.en: Click + New Record. Fill the Asset name, pick the Category (it proposes the Useful life and Method), then the dates, cost and residual value.
steps.id: Klik + New Record. Isi Asset name, pilih Category (otomatis mengusulkan Useful life dan Method), lalu tanggal, harga perolehan, dan nilai sisa.

steps.en: Pick the Capitalization credit account, optionally a Cost center, Location and Source document.
steps.id: Pilih Capitalization credit account, dan bila perlu Cost center, Location, dan Source document.

steps.en: Click Save to keep a Draft, or Save & Capitalize to book the asset (Dr asset / Cr the credit account) and start its depreciation schedule.
steps.id: Klik Save untuk menyimpan Draft, atau Save & Capitalize untuk membukukan aset (Dr aset / Cr akun lawan) dan memulai jadwal penyusutan.

steps.en: A Draft asset can be edited and capitalized later from its row. Open an asset to see its monthly schedule: charge, accumulated and book value.
steps.id: Aset Draft bisa diedit dan dikapitalisasi kemudian dari barisnya. Buka aset untuk melihat jadwal bulanannya: beban, akumulasi, dan nilai buku.

steps.en: Each month, on the older asset page choose the period, click Run Depreciation, check the preview and click Post Depreciation Journal.
steps.id: Tiap bulan, di halaman aset lama pilih periode, klik Run Depreciation, periksa pratinjau, lalu klik Post Depreciation Journal.

steps.en: To sell or write off an Active asset, open it and click Dispose; enter the Disposal date, Proceeds and where the money goes, then Post Disposal.
steps.id: Untuk menjual atau menghapus aset Active, buka aset lalu klik Dispose; isi Disposal date, Proceeds, dan akun penerima uang, lalu Post Disposal.

fields.label: Asset name
fields.en: Name of the asset, up to 150 characters, for example Mesin Cetak Offset Komori 4 warna. Required.
fields.id: Nama aset, maksimal 150 karakter, misalnya Mesin Cetak Offset Komori 4 warna. Wajib diisi.

fields.label: Category
fields.en: The asset category from the active fixed asset categories. It sets the default Useful life and Method, the expense account for depreciation and the tax group. Required.
fields.id: Kategori aset dari kategori aset tetap yang aktif. Menentukan Useful life dan Method bawaan, akun beban penyusutan, serta kelompok pajak. Wajib diisi.

fields.label: Cost center
fields.en: Optional. The cost center that carries the depreciation of this asset.
fields.id: Opsional. Cost center yang menanggung penyusutan aset ini.

fields.label: Acquisition date
fields.en: The date the asset was bought. The first review date is set one year after it. Required.
fields.id: Tanggal aset dibeli. Tanggal tinjau pertama diatur satu tahun sesudahnya. Wajib diisi.

fields.label: Depreciation start
fields.en: The first month depreciation is charged, normally the start of the acquisition month. Required.
fields.id: Bulan pertama penyusutan dibebankan, biasanya awal bulan perolehan. Wajib diisi.

fields.label: Acquisition cost (IDR)
fields.en: The purchase cost in Rupiah, at least 1. It is the starting point of the book value. Required.
fields.id: Harga perolehan dalam Rupiah, minimal 1. Menjadi titik awal nilai buku. Wajib diisi.

fields.label: Residual value (IDR)
fields.en: The value expected at the end of life, in Rupiah. Must be lower than the cost. Default 0.
fields.id: Nilai yang diperkirakan tersisa di akhir umur aset, dalam Rupiah. Harus lebih kecil dari harga perolehan. Bawaan 0.

fields.label: Useful life (months)
fields.en: How many months the asset is depreciated, from 1 to 600. Proposed by the category; you can change it.
fields.id: Berapa bulan aset disusutkan, dari 1 sampai 600. Diusulkan oleh kategori; boleh diubah.

fields.label: Method
fields.en: Straight line (equal charge each month) or Double declining balance. A hint shows the approximate first-month charge.
fields.id: Garis lurus (beban sama tiap bulan) atau Saldo menurun ganda. Ada petunjuk perkiraan beban bulan pertama.

fields.label: Location
fields.en: Optional free text for where the asset is, for example Pabrik - Ruang Cetak. Shown as the Location column.
fields.id: Teks bebas opsional untuk lokasi aset, misalnya Pabrik - Ruang Cetak. Tampil di kolom Location.

fields.label: Source document
fields.en: Optional reference of the document the purchase came from, for example a supplier bill number or contract.
fields.id: Referensi opsional dokumen asal pembelian, misalnya nomor tagihan supplier atau kontrak.

fields.label: Capitalization credit account
fields.en: The account credited when the asset is capitalized: a cash or bank account, a payable, or GR/IR Clearing when the goods are already received. Required.
fields.id: Akun yang dikredit saat aset dikapitalisasi: akun kas atau bank, hutang, atau GR/IR Clearing bila barang sudah diterima. Wajib diisi.

fields.label: Disposal date
fields.en: In the Dispose window: the date the asset is sold or written off. Required.
fields.id: Di jendela Dispose: tanggal aset dijual atau dihapus. Wajib diisi.

fields.label: Proceeds (IDR)
fields.en: In the Dispose window: the money received for the asset, in Rupiah. Enter 0 for a write-off. The difference to book value goes to other gain or loss.
fields.id: Di jendela Dispose: uang yang diterima dari aset, dalam Rupiah. Isi 0 bila hanya dihapus. Selisih terhadap nilai buku masuk ke laba atau rugi lain-lain.

fields.label: Proceeds to
fields.en: In the Dispose window: the cash or bank account that receives the proceeds. Required.
fields.id: Di jendela Dispose: akun kas atau bank yang menerima hasil penjualan. Wajib diisi.

fields.label: Net Book Value
fields.en: List column, read-only: cost minus accumulated depreciation. Accumulated and the Status (Draft, Active, Fully depreciated, Disposed) are also read-only columns.
fields.id: Kolom daftar, hanya baca: harga perolehan dikurangi akumulasi penyusutan. Accumulated dan Status (Draft, Active, Fully depreciated, Disposed) juga kolom hanya baca.

title: Amortization

purpose.en: Schedules that spread a prepaid expense, an intangible asset or a leasehold improvement over several months. Open it to create a schedule, run the monthly amortization, and see how much is still unamortized.
purpose.id: Jadwal yang membagi beban dibayar di muka, aset tak berwujud, atau renovasi bangunan sewa ke beberapa bulan. Buka untuk membuat jadwal, menjalankan amortisasi bulanan, dan melihat sisa yang belum diamortisasi.

keywords: amortisasi, amortization, prabayar, prepaid, biaya dibayar di muka, asuransi, sewa dibayar dimuka, aset tak berwujud, intangible, leasehold, lisensi, jadwal amortisasi, polis

steps.en: Open Amortization. Filter by Category or Status, or use the stat boxes. Open a row to see its month-by-month schedule.
steps.id: Buka Amortization. Saring menurut Category atau Status, atau pakai kotak statistik. Buka baris untuk melihat jadwalnya bulan demi bulan.

steps.en: Click + New Record. Fill the Schedule name, pick the Category and the Period (months); the category proposes the period.
steps.id: Klik + New Record. Isi Schedule name, pilih Category dan Period (months); kategori mengusulkan lama periode.

steps.en: Set the Document date, the Amortization start, the Amount (IDR) and a Reference such as a policy or contract number.
steps.id: Atur Document date, Amortization start, Amount (IDR), dan Reference seperti nomor polis atau kontrak.

steps.en: Pick Paid from / payable to, then click Save. The schedule is booked at once (Dr prepaid or intangible account / Cr the account you picked) and becomes Active.
steps.id: Pilih Paid from / payable to, lalu klik Save. Jadwal langsung dibukukan (Dr akun prabayar atau tak berwujud / Cr akun yang dipilih) dan menjadi Active.

steps.en: Each month, on the older amortization page choose the period, preview the run, and click Post Amortization Journal.
steps.id: Tiap bulan, di halaman amortisasi lama pilih periode, lihat pratinjau, lalu klik Post Amortization Journal.

fields.label: Schedule name
fields.en: Name of the schedule, up to 150 characters, for example Asuransi Kendaraan 2026 or Lisensi ERP. Required.
fields.id: Nama jadwal, maksimal 150 karakter, misalnya Asuransi Kendaraan 2026 atau Lisensi ERP. Wajib diisi.

fields.label: Category
fields.en: Prepaid, intangible or leasehold category from the active categories. It decides the accounts used and the default period. Required.
fields.id: Kategori prabayar, tak berwujud, atau leasehold dari kategori yang aktif. Menentukan akun yang dipakai dan periode bawaan. Wajib diisi.

fields.label: Period (months)
fields.en: Number of months to spread the amount over, from 1 to 600. The monthly expense is the amount divided by this number (straight line, no residual value).
fields.id: Jumlah bulan untuk membagi nilai, dari 1 sampai 600. Beban bulanan adalah nilai dibagi angka ini (garis lurus, tanpa nilai sisa).

fields.label: Document date
fields.en: The date of the invoice, policy or contract. Required.
fields.id: Tanggal invoice, polis, atau kontrak. Wajib diisi.

fields.label: Amortization start
fields.en: The first month the expense is charged, normally the start of the month. Required.
fields.id: Bulan pertama beban dibebankan, biasanya awal bulan. Wajib diisi.

fields.label: Amount (IDR)
fields.en: The total amount to amortize, in Rupiah, at least 1. A hint shows the monthly expense. Required.
fields.id: Total nilai yang diamortisasi, dalam Rupiah, minimal 1. Ada petunjuk beban bulanan. Wajib diisi.

fields.label: Reference
fields.en: Optional reference such as a policy number, for example Polis 2026-0011. Shown in the Source Document column.
fields.id: Referensi opsional seperti nomor polis, misalnya Polis 2026-0011. Tampil di kolom Source Document.

fields.label: Paid from / payable to
fields.en: The account credited when the schedule is booked: a cash or bank account, or a payable. Default is bank 111200. Required.
fields.id: Akun yang dikredit saat jadwal dibukukan: akun kas atau bank, atau hutang. Bawaan bank 111200. Wajib diisi.

fields.label: Net Book Value
fields.en: List column, read-only: the amount not yet amortized. Accumulated and the Status (Draft, Active, Fully depreciated, Disposed) are also read-only columns.
fields.id: Kolom daftar, hanya baca: nilai yang belum diamortisasi. Accumulated dan Status (Draft, Active, Fully depreciated, Disposed) juga kolom hanya baca.

title: Petty Cash

purpose.en: The petty cash fund for small cash purchases. Open it to give a cash advance for an approved Cash PO or settle it with the receipts. You can also reimburse a purchase made first, top up the fund from the bank, or cancel a wrong entry.
purpose.id: Dana kas kecil untuk belanja tunai kecil. Buka untuk memberi kasbon bagi PO Kontan yang sudah disetujui atau mempertanggungjawabkannya dengan nota. Bisa juga mengganti belanja yang dibayar dulu, mengisi ulang dari bank, atau membatalkan input.

keywords: kas kecil, petty cash, kasbon, cash advance, po kontan, cash po, nota, settlement, pertanggungjawaban, reimburse, isi ulang, top up, imprest, plafon, pemegang kas, custodian, belanja tunai

steps.en: Open Kas Kecil (Petty Cash). The boxes show Imprest Limit, Cash on Hand, Open Cash Advances and To Top Up. The upper list holds approved Cash POs waiting for a next step; the lower list is the history.
steps.id: Buka Kas Kecil (Petty Cash). Kotak di atas menampilkan Imprest Limit, Cash on Hand, Open Cash Advances, dan To Top Up. Daftar atas berisi PO Kontan yang sudah disetujui dan menunggu langkah berikut; daftar bawah adalah riwayat.

steps.en: Open a waiting Cash PO. If its Next Step is Give Advance, enter the Advance Amount and Given To, then click Give Advance and confirm. Cash leaves the fund.
steps.id: Buka PO Kontan yang menunggu. Bila Next Step-nya Give Advance, isi Advance Amount dan Given To, lalu klik Give Advance dan konfirmasi. Uang keluar dari dana kas kecil.

steps.en: After shopping, open the same Cash PO (Next Step Settlement), enter the Receipt amount for every line, attach the Receipt Photo / Scan, and click Post Settlement.
steps.id: Setelah belanja, buka PO Kontan yang sama (Next Step Settlement), isi nilai nota tiap baris, lampirkan Receipt Photo / Scan, lalu klik Post Settlement.

steps.en: For a Cash PO bought first with the buyer's own money (Next Step Reimburse), enter the receipt amounts, Paid To and the photo, then click Pay Reimburse.
steps.id: Untuk PO Kontan yang dibeli dulu dengan uang pembeli (Next Step Reimburse), isi nilai nota, Paid To, dan foto, lalu klik Pay Reimburse.

steps.en: To refill the fund, click Top Up. The suggested amount is limit minus cash on hand minus open advances. Pick the From Account and Date, then click Top Up.
steps.id: Untuk mengisi ulang dana, klik Top Up. Nilai usulan adalah plafon dikurangi kas di tangan dan kasbon terbuka. Pilih From Account dan Date, lalu klik Top Up.

steps.en: To change the fund name, custodian or limit, click Setting and Save. To undo a wrong entry, open it from the history, type a Cancel Reason and click Cancel Transaction.
steps.id: Untuk mengubah nama dana, pemegang kas, atau plafon, klik Setting lalu Save. Untuk membatalkan input yang salah, buka dari riwayat, isi Cancel Reason, lalu klik Cancel Transaction.

fields.label: Advance Amount
fields.en: Cash Advance form: the money handed to the buyer, in Rupiah. Proposed as the PO total. Must be above zero and not more than the Cash on Hand.
fields.id: Form Cash Advance: uang yang diserahkan ke pembeli, dalam Rupiah. Diusulkan sebesar total PO. Harus di atas nol dan tidak melebihi Cash on Hand.

fields.label: Given To
fields.en: Cash Advance form: the name of the buyer who receives the money. Required, up to 100 characters.
fields.id: Form Cash Advance: nama pembeli yang menerima uang. Wajib diisi, maksimal 100 karakter.

fields.label: Receipt
fields.en: Settlement and Reimburse form: one amount per PO line, taken from the shop receipt, in Rupiah. Each must be above zero. The PO price is replaced by it; change or shortfall is worked out automatically.
fields.id: Form Settlement dan Reimburse: satu nilai per baris PO, diambil dari nota toko, dalam Rupiah. Tiap nilai harus di atas nol. Harga PO diganti nilai ini; kembalian atau kurang bayar dihitung otomatis.

fields.label: Paid To
fields.en: Reimburse form only: the name of the buyer who is paid back. Required, up to 100 characters.
fields.id: Hanya form Reimburse: nama pembeli yang diganti uangnya. Wajib diisi, maksimal 100 karakter.

fields.label: Receipt Photo / Scan
fields.en: Optional upload of the receipt (jpg, jpeg, png or pdf, up to 10 MB). Kept with the transaction and shown as a Receipt Photo button.
fields.id: Unggah nota (jpg, jpeg, png, atau pdf, maksimal 10 MB), opsional. Disimpan bersama transaksi dan tampil sebagai tombol Receipt Photo.

fields.label: Top Up Amount
fields.en: Top Up form: the money moved from the bank into petty cash, in Rupiah. Must be above zero.
fields.id: Form Top Up: uang yang dipindah dari bank ke kas kecil, dalam Rupiah. Harus di atas nol.

fields.label: From Account
fields.en: Top Up form: the bank or cash account the money comes from. Required.
fields.id: Form Top Up: akun bank atau kas sumber uang. Wajib diisi.

fields.label: Date
fields.en: Top Up form: the date of the top up. Required. Default is today.
fields.id: Form Top Up: tanggal isi ulang. Wajib diisi. Bawaan hari ini.

fields.label: Notes
fields.en: Top Up form: optional note, up to 255 characters.
fields.id: Form Top Up: catatan opsional, maksimal 255 karakter.

fields.label: Petty Cash Name
fields.en: Setting form: the name of the fund, up to 100 characters. Required.
fields.id: Form Setting: nama dana kas kecil, maksimal 100 karakter. Wajib diisi.

fields.label: Custodian
fields.en: Setting form: the active user who holds the cash. Required. Shown at the top of the screen.
fields.id: Form Setting: pengguna aktif yang memegang uang kas. Wajib diisi. Tampil di bagian atas layar.

fields.label: Imprest Limit
fields.en: Setting form: the fixed amount the fund is kept at. Top Up refills up to this limit. Optional; while empty the screen shows not set.
fields.id: Form Setting: jumlah tetap yang dijaga di dana kas kecil. Top Up mengisi ulang sampai batas ini. Opsional; bila kosong layar menampilkan not set.

fields.label: Cancel Reason
fields.en: Cancel Transaction form: why the entry was wrong, at least 10 characters. The journal is reversed and the transaction stays as Cancelled. A step that was followed by a later step must be cancelled from the later step first.
fields.id: Form Cancel Transaction: alasan input salah, minimal 10 karakter. Jurnal dibalik dan transaksi tetap ada dengan status Cancelled. Langkah yang sudah diikuti langkah berikutnya harus dibatalkan dari langkah berikutnya dulu.

fields.label: Cash on Hand
fields.en: Read-only box: the current cash balance of the fund. Imprest Limit, Open Cash Advances (advances not yet settled) and To Top Up are the other read-only boxes.
fields.id: Kotak hanya baca: saldo kas dana saat ini. Imprest Limit, Open Cash Advances (kasbon yang belum dipertanggungjawabkan), dan To Top Up adalah kotak hanya baca lainnya.

title: General Ledger

purpose.en: Every posted journal line, newest first. Open it to trace how an account moved, see which journal made a posting, or check one month. The balance of each account is in Trial Balance.
purpose.id: Semua baris jurnal yang sudah diposting, terbaru di atas. Buka untuk menelusuri pergerakan sebuah akun, melihat jurnal mana yang membuat suatu posting, atau memeriksa satu bulan. Saldo tiap akun ada di Trial Balance.

keywords: buku besar, general ledger, gl, ledger, jurnal, posting, mutasi akun, kartu akun, debit, kredit, periode, laporan akuntansi

steps.en: Open General Ledger. Only journals that are Posted and not cancelled are listed.
steps.id: Buka General Ledger. Hanya jurnal yang Posted dan tidak dibatalkan yang ditampilkan.

steps.en: Type a journal number, account or description in the search box to narrow the list.
steps.id: Ketik nomor jurnal, akun, atau keterangan di kotak cari untuk mempersempit daftar.

steps.en: Use the Period, Account Class and Account filters, for example Period 2026-10 for one month.
steps.id: Pakai filter Period, Account Class, dan Account, misalnya Period 2026-10 untuk satu bulan.

steps.en: Group by Account to read one account with its debit and credit subtotal. You can also group by Period, Journal No. or Account Class.
steps.id: Kelompokkan menurut Account untuk membaca satu akun beserta subtotal debit dan kreditnya. Bisa juga dikelompokkan menurut Period, Journal No., atau Account Class.

steps.en: Use the column chooser to show hidden columns such as Partner, Reference and Account Class. The totals of Debit and Credit are summed at the bottom.
steps.id: Pakai pemilih kolom untuk menampilkan kolom tersembunyi seperti Partner, Reference, dan Account Class. Total Debit dan Credit dijumlahkan di bagian bawah.

fields.label: Date
fields.en: Column: the journal's entry date. Rows are sorted by it, newest first.
fields.id: Kolom: tanggal jurnal. Baris diurutkan menurut tanggal ini, terbaru di atas.

fields.label: Period
fields.en: Column, filter and grouping: the year and month of the journal, for example 2026-10. Use it to look at one month.
fields.id: Kolom, filter, dan pengelompokan: tahun dan bulan jurnal, misalnya 2026-10. Dipakai untuk melihat satu bulan.

fields.label: Journal No.
fields.en: Column and grouping: the number of the journal or voucher the line belongs to. Group by it to see all lines of one journal together.
fields.id: Kolom dan pengelompokan: nomor jurnal atau voucher tempat baris ini berada. Kelompokkan untuk melihat semua baris satu jurnal bersama.

fields.label: Account
fields.en: Column, filter and grouping: the account name with its code. Group by it to read one account with its subtotals.
fields.id: Kolom, filter, dan pengelompokan: nama akun beserta kodenya. Kelompokkan untuk membaca satu akun dengan subtotalnya.

fields.label: Account Class
fields.en: Hidden column, filter and grouping: Asset, Liability, Equity, Revenue, Cost of sales, Expense, Other income or Other expense.
fields.id: Kolom tersembunyi, filter, dan pengelompokan: Asset, Liability, Equity, Revenue, Cost of sales, Expense, Other income, atau Other expense.

fields.label: Description
fields.en: Column: the line's narration, or the journal description when the line has none.
fields.id: Kolom: keterangan baris, atau keterangan jurnal bila baris tidak punya.

fields.label: Partner
fields.en: Hidden column: the party named on the voucher, for example the payee of a cash voucher.
fields.id: Kolom tersembunyi: pihak yang tercantum di voucher, misalnya penerima pada voucher kas.

fields.label: Reference
fields.en: Hidden column: the reference number typed on the journal or voucher.
fields.id: Kolom tersembunyi: nomor referensi yang diketik di jurnal atau voucher.

fields.label: Debit
fields.en: Column: the debit amount of the line. Summed at the bottom and in each group.
fields.id: Kolom: nilai debit baris. Dijumlahkan di bagian bawah dan di tiap kelompok.

fields.label: Credit
fields.en: Column: the credit amount of the line. Summed at the bottom and in each group.
fields.id: Kolom: nilai kredit baris. Dijumlahkan di bagian bawah dan di tiap kelompok.

title: Trial Balance

purpose.en: The balance of every postable account as of today, built from posted journals. Open it to check that total debit equals total credit before closing, or to see which accounts carry a balance.
purpose.id: Saldo semua akun yang bisa diposting per hari ini, dihitung dari jurnal yang sudah diposting. Buka untuk memastikan total debit sama dengan total kredit sebelum tutup buku, atau untuk melihat akun mana yang bersaldo.

keywords: neraca saldo, trial balance, saldo akun, tb, debit kredit, saldo, tutup buku, closing, laporan keuangan, balance

steps.en: Open Trial Balance. Each postable account is listed with its balance as of today.
steps.id: Buka Trial Balance. Tiap akun yang bisa diposting ditampilkan beserta saldonya per hari ini.

steps.en: Use the stat boxes All, Has balance and Zero, or the Account Class and Balance filters, to narrow the list.
steps.id: Pakai kotak statistik All, Has balance, dan Zero, atau filter Account Class dan Balance, untuk mempersempit daftar.

steps.en: Group by Account Class to see a subtotal per class.
steps.id: Kelompokkan menurut Account Class untuk melihat subtotal tiap kelas.

steps.en: Check the totals at the bottom: total Debit and total Credit must be equal.
steps.id: Periksa total di bagian bawah: total Debit dan total Credit harus sama.

steps.en: To see the journal lines behind a balance, open General Ledger and filter or group by that account.
steps.id: Untuk melihat baris jurnal di balik suatu saldo, buka General Ledger lalu saring atau kelompokkan menurut akun itu.

fields.label: Account
fields.en: Column: the account name with its code. Inactive accounts appear only when they still have a balance.
fields.id: Kolom: nama akun beserta kodenya. Akun nonaktif hanya tampil bila masih punya saldo.

fields.label: Account Class
fields.en: Column, filter and grouping: Asset, Liability, Equity, Revenue, Cost of sales, Expense, Other income or Other expense.
fields.id: Kolom, filter, dan pengelompokan: Asset, Liability, Equity, Revenue, Cost of sales, Expense, Other income, atau Other expense.

fields.label: Normal Balance
fields.en: Hidden column: Debit or Credit, the side on which the account normally increases, as set in Master of Accounts.
fields.id: Kolom tersembunyi: Debit atau Credit, sisi tempat akun normalnya bertambah, sesuai pengaturan di Master of Accounts.

fields.label: Debit
fields.en: Column: the account balance when its net balance is on the debit side, otherwise 0. Summed at the bottom.
fields.id: Kolom: saldo akun bila saldo bersihnya di sisi debit, selain itu 0. Dijumlahkan di bagian bawah.

fields.label: Credit
fields.en: Column: the account balance when its net balance is on the credit side, otherwise 0. Summed at the bottom.
fields.id: Kolom: saldo akun bila saldo bersihnya di sisi kredit, selain itu 0. Dijumlahkan di bagian bawah.

fields.label: Balance
fields.en: Column and filter: Has balance or Zero. Tells at a glance whether the account has any balance today.
fields.id: Kolom dan filter: Has balance atau Zero. Menunjukkan sekilas apakah akun punya saldo hari ini.

title: Customer Invoice

purpose.en: Bills to customers, their down payments and the money received for them, in one list. Open it to invoice goods the customer has received, to bill a down payment, to record a payment, and to see what is still unpaid.
purpose.id: Tagihan ke customer, uang mukanya, dan uang yang diterima, dalam satu daftar. Buka layar ini untuk menagih barang yang sudah diterima customer, menagih uang muka, mencatat pembayaran, dan melihat tagihan yang belum lunas.

keywords: customer invoice, invoice, faktur tagihan, tagihan customer, faktur, piutang, uang muka, down payment, dp, tagihan uang muka, tanda terima uang muka, order to cash, ar, sisa tagihan, pelunasan, pembayaran customer, terima pembayaran

steps.en: Before invoicing, record the Proof of Delivery of the delivery note. Only lines the customer has received can be invoiced.
steps.id: Sebelum menagih, catat Proof of Delivery untuk Surat Jalannya. Hanya baris yang sudah diterima customer yang bisa ditagih.

steps.en: Click + New Record. Choose Invoice or Down Payment, pick the Customer Order, then click Next (Invoice) or Create (Down Payment).
steps.id: Klik + New Record. Pilih Invoice atau Down Payment, pilih Customer Order, lalu klik Next (Invoice) atau Create (Down Payment).

steps.en: For an Invoice, set Invoice to No on delivery note lines you do not bill now, then click Create. A Draft is made with the price from the Customer Order.
steps.id: Untuk Invoice, ubah Invoice menjadi Tidak pada baris Surat Jalan yang belum ditagih sekarang, lalu klik Create. Draft dibuat dengan harga dari Customer Order.

steps.en: Check the Draft: Invoice Date, Payment Term, Transfer To, Qty Invoiced, and the down payment that is applied. Click Save to recalculate.
steps.id: Periksa Draft: Invoice Date, Payment Term, Transfer To, Qty Invoiced, dan uang muka yang dipotong. Klik Save untuk menghitung ulang.

steps.en: Click Confirm. The invoice number is issued from the number series, the journal is posted and the delivery note lines are marked as invoiced.
steps.id: Klik Confirm. Nomor invoice terbit dari seri nomor, jurnal diposting, dan baris Surat Jalan ditandai sudah ditagih.

steps.en: Click Print for the invoice. After Confirm the document cannot be changed; a mistake is corrected with Cancel and a reason, while no payment exists.
steps.id: Klik Print untuk mencetak invoice. Sesudah Confirm dokumen tidak bisa diubah; kesalahan dikoreksi dengan Cancel dan alasannya, selama belum ada pembayaran.

steps.en: For a Down Payment: fill Percent of Order or Bill Amount, Save, Confirm, and print it. No journal is posted yet.
steps.id: Untuk Down Payment: isi Percent of Order atau Bill Amount, Save, Confirm, lalu cetak. Belum ada jurnal yang diposting.

steps.en: When the down payment money arrives, open the document, click Record Receipt, fill the date, bank account and amount, then Confirm Receipt. Print Receipt gives the receipt for the customer.
steps.id: Saat uang muka masuk, buka dokumennya, klik Record Receipt, isi tanggal, rekening, dan nilainya, lalu Confirm Receipt. Print Receipt mencetak tanda terima untuk customer.

steps.en: When the customer pays an invoice, open it and click Record Payment. Fill the date and bank account, type Paid Now on the invoices that are paid, then Confirm Payment. A fully paid invoice becomes Closed.
steps.id: Saat customer membayar invoice, buka invoicenya dan klik Record Payment. Isi tanggal dan rekening, ketik Paid Now pada invoice yang dibayar, lalu Confirm Payment. Invoice yang lunas menjadi Closed.

steps.en: Tab Delivery shows the proof behind the invoice. Every line comes from a delivery note: what was shipped, what the customer received, the reason for a difference, who received it and when.
steps.id: Tab Delivery memuat bukti di balik invoice. Tiap baris berasal dari Surat Jalan: yang dikirim, yang diterima customer, alasan selisih, siapa yang menerima dan kapan.

steps.en: On a Down Payment Invoice, tab Down Payment History lists everything that happened to the down payments of that order: invoiced, money received, deducted on which invoice, and the balance.
steps.id: Di Down Payment Invoice, tab Down Payment History memuat semua yang terjadi pada uang muka order itu: ditagih, uang diterima, dipotong di invoice mana, dan saldonya.

fields.label: Customer Order
fields.en: Picked when the Draft is made. Invoice lists orders with received delivery notes not yet invoiced; Down Payment lists confirmed orders. One document belongs to one order.
fields.id: Dipilih saat Draft dibuat. Invoice menampilkan order dengan Surat Jalan diterima yang belum ditagih; Down Payment menampilkan order Confirmed. Satu dokumen untuk satu order.

fields.label: Invoice
fields.en: On the new invoice step: Yes = this delivery note line goes into the Draft, No = it stays for a later invoice.
fields.id: Di langkah invoice baru: Ya = baris Surat Jalan ini masuk Draft, Tidak = ditagih di invoice berikutnya.

fields.label: Invoice Date
fields.en: Filled by the system with the date of the latest delivery note on the invoice. It may be changed while the accounting period is open. The due date and the number month follow it.
fields.id: Diisi sistem dengan tanggal Surat Jalan terakhir di invoice. Boleh diubah selama periode buku masih terbuka. Jatuh tempo dan bulan pada nomor mengikutinya.

fields.label: Customer PO No.
fields.en: Copied from the Customer Order; may be corrected. Printed on the invoice.
fields.id: Disalin dari Customer Order; boleh dikoreksi. Dicetak di invoice.

fields.label: Payment Term
fields.en: Copied from the Customer Order, picked from Payment Terms. The due date is the invoice date plus the days of the term.
fields.id: Disalin dari Customer Order, dipilih dari Payment Terms. Jatuh tempo = tanggal invoice ditambah hari pada syarat bayar.

fields.label: Transfer To
fields.en: The company bank account printed on the invoice. Picked from Company Bank Accounts; the default follows the tax identity of the order. Required before Confirm.
fields.id: Rekening perusahaan yang dicetak di invoice. Dipilih dari Company Bank Accounts; bawaan mengikuti identitas pajak order. Wajib sebelum Confirm.

fields.label: Bill To
fields.en: Customer name on the invoice, copied from Master Customer; may be changed for this invoice only.
fields.id: Nama customer di invoice, disalin dari Master Customer; boleh diubah untuk invoice ini saja.

fields.label: Bill To Address
fields.en: Billing address, copied from Master Customer; may be changed for this invoice only.
fields.id: Alamat tagih, disalin dari Master Customer; boleh diubah untuk invoice ini saja.

fields.label: Other Charges
fields.en: Freight or another cost billed to the customer on this invoice. It is added to the tax base. Leave 0 when there is none.
fields.id: Ongkos kirim atau biaya lain yang ditagihkan ke customer di invoice ini. Ikut masuk dasar pajak. Isi 0 bila tidak ada.

fields.label: Other Charges Note
fields.en: Short text that names the other charge; printed in the totals.
fields.id: Teks singkat nama biaya lain; dicetak di bagian total.

fields.label: Qty Invoiced
fields.en: Filled with what is left to invoice on the delivery note line. Lower it to bill part of it now; it cannot be more than received minus already invoiced.
fields.id: Terisi sisa yang belum ditagih pada baris Surat Jalan. Kurangi bila menagih sebagian dulu; tidak boleh lebih dari qty diterima dikurangi yang sudah ditagih.

fields.label: Apply to This Invoice
fields.en: Down payment of the same order that was received and is not used up, proposed by the system. Lower it to keep part for a later invoice.
fields.id: Uang muka order yang sama yang sudah diterima dan belum habis, diusulkan sistem. Kurangi bila sebagian disimpan untuk invoice berikutnya.

fields.label: Tax Invoice No.
fields.en: The tax invoice number given by Coretax after upload. Only for VAT orders; may be filled in later.
fields.id: Nomor Faktur Pajak dari Coretax sesudah diunggah. Hanya untuk order PPN; boleh diisi belakangan.

fields.label: Notes
fields.en: Free text printed on the invoice.
fields.id: Teks bebas yang dicetak di invoice.

fields.label: Percent of Order
fields.en: Down Payment only: percentage of the order total to bill. The default comes from Constants. Leave empty to type Bill Amount yourself.
fields.id: Hanya Down Payment: persen dari nilai order yang ditagih. Bawaan dari Constants. Kosongkan bila Bill Amount diketik sendiri.

fields.label: Bill Amount
fields.en: Down Payment only: the amount billed when Percent of Order is empty. It includes VAT on a VAT order.
fields.id: Hanya Down Payment: nilai yang ditagih bila Percent of Order kosong. Sudah termasuk PPN untuk order PPN.

fields.label: Description
fields.en: Down Payment only: the text printed on the down payment invoice line.
fields.id: Hanya Down Payment: teks yang dicetak di baris tagihan uang muka.

fields.label: Received Date
fields.en: Record Receipt: the date the money arrived. It becomes the date of the journal.
fields.id: Record Receipt: tanggal uang masuk. Menjadi tanggal jurnalnya.

fields.label: Amount Received
fields.en: Record Receipt: how much arrived. Less than the bill leaves the down payment partly paid.
fields.id: Record Receipt: jumlah uang yang masuk. Kurang dari tagihan berarti uang muka baru dibayar sebagian.

fields.label: Received In
fields.en: Record Receipt: the company bank account that received the money. It needs a ledger account in Company Bank Accounts.
fields.id: Record Receipt: rekening perusahaan yang menerima uang. Rekening harus punya akun buku besar di Company Bank Accounts.

fields.label: Paid Now
fields.en: Record Payment: the amount paid on each open invoice of this customer. It cannot be more than Outstanding. Leave empty on invoices not paid by this receipt.
fields.id: Record Payment: nilai yang dibayar untuk tiap invoice terbuka customer ini. Tidak boleh lebih dari Outstanding. Kosongkan pada invoice yang tidak dibayar lewat penerimaan ini.

fields.label: Note
fields.en: Record Payment: short text for the bank receipt voucher, for example the transfer reference.
fields.id: Record Payment: teks singkat untuk bukti bank masuk, misalnya referensi transfer.

fields.label: Reason for Difference
fields.en: Why the customer received less than what was shipped (damaged in transit, returned, short shipped). From the Proof of Delivery. What was not received is not invoiced.
fields.id: Mengapa customer menerima kurang dari yang dikirim (rusak di jalan, diretur, kurang kirim). Dari Proof of Delivery. Yang tidak diterima tidak ditagih.

fields.label: Signed Note
fields.en: Whether a photo of the signed delivery note is stored with the Proof of Delivery.
fields.id: Apakah foto Surat Jalan bertanda tangan tersimpan di Proof of Delivery.

fields.label: Down Payment Left
fields.en: Down Payment Invoice: money received and not deducted on an invoice yet.
fields.id: Down Payment Invoice: uang yang sudah diterima dan belum dipotong di invoice.

fields.label: Open Customer Order
fields.en: Opens the order this document belongs to. Every invoice and every down payment belongs to one Customer Order.
fields.id: Membuka order pemilik dokumen ini. Tiap invoice dan tiap uang muka milik satu Customer Order.

title: Company Bank Accounts

purpose.en: The bank accounts of the company. They are printed on customer invoices as the account to transfer to, and they are where received money is posted.
purpose.id: Rekening bank perusahaan. Dicetak di invoice customer sebagai rekening tujuan transfer, dan menjadi tempat uang yang diterima dicatat.

keywords: bank, rekening, rekening perusahaan, company bank, bank account, transfer, bca, maspion, bni, no rekening, atas nama

steps.en: Type directly in the cells. Add a new account in the empty row at the bottom.
steps.id: Ketik langsung di sel. Tambah rekening baru di baris kosong paling bawah.

steps.en: Fill Bank, Account No., Account Holder and Tax Identity.
steps.id: Isi Bank, Account No., Account Holder, dan Tax Identity.

steps.en: Tick Default for the account proposed on new invoices of that tax identity. Only one account per identity stays the default.
steps.id: Centang Default untuk rekening yang diusulkan di invoice baru identitas pajak itu. Hanya satu rekening per identitas yang menjadi bawaan.

steps.en: Fill Ledger Account with the account code from Master of Accounts, then click Save.
steps.id: Isi Ledger Account dengan kode akun dari Master of Accounts, lalu klik Save.

fields.label: Bank
fields.en: Name of the bank, as printed on the invoice.
fields.id: Nama bank, seperti yang dicetak di invoice.

fields.label: Account No.
fields.en: The bank account number.
fields.id: Nomor rekening.

fields.label: Account Holder
fields.en: The name the account is in.
fields.id: Nama pemilik rekening.

fields.label: Tax Identity
fields.en: PPN = for documents of the VAT entity, Non PPN = for non-VAT documents, Both = for either.
fields.id: PPN = untuk dokumen PPN, Non PPN = untuk dokumen Non PPN, Both = untuk keduanya.

fields.label: Default
fields.en: The account proposed on a new invoice of that tax identity.
fields.id: Rekening yang diusulkan di invoice baru identitas pajak itu.

fields.label: Ledger Account
fields.en: Account code in Master of Accounts where money received in this bank account is posted. It must be an account that can be journaled. Empty = money cannot be received into this account yet.
fields.id: Kode akun di Master of Accounts tempat uang yang masuk ke rekening ini dicatat. Harus akun yang bisa dijurnal. Kosong = rekening belum bisa menerima uang.

fields.label: Active
fields.en: Untick to stop using the account on new documents.
fields.id: Hilangkan centang bila rekening tidak dipakai lagi di dokumen baru.

title: To Invoice

purpose.en: Orders whose delivery notes are not fully invoiced yet. Open it every day to see what can be billed now and which delivery notes still wait for the customer's signed proof of delivery.
purpose.id: Order yang Surat Jalannya belum habis ditagih. Buka tiap hari untuk melihat apa yang bisa ditagih sekarang dan Surat Jalan mana yang masih menunggu bukti terima bertanda tangan dari customer.

keywords: to invoice, belum ditagih, siap ditagih, surat jalan belum ditagih, unbilled delivery, menunggu bukti terima, proof of delivery, tagihan, daftar kerja finance

steps.en: Open To Invoice. Each row is one Customer Order with delivery notes that are not fully invoiced.
steps.id: Buka To Invoice. Tiap baris adalah satu Customer Order yang Surat Jalannya belum habis ditagih.

steps.en: Status Ready to invoice: the customer has received the goods (Proof of Delivery recorded). Status Waiting proof of delivery: the goods were shipped, but the signed delivery note is not recorded yet, so nothing can be billed.
steps.id: Status Ready to invoice: customer sudah menerima barang (Proof of Delivery sudah dicatat). Status Waiting proof of delivery: barang sudah dikirim, tetapi Surat Jalan bertanda tangan belum dicatat, jadi belum bisa ditagih.

steps.en: Click the arrow at the left of a row to see its delivery note lines: shipped, received, already invoiced.
steps.id: Klik panah di kiri baris untuk melihat baris Surat Jalannya: dikirim, diterima, sudah ditagih.

steps.en: Open a Ready row. Customer Invoice opens with the delivery note lines of that order; set Invoice to No for a line you do not bill now, then Create.
steps.id: Buka baris yang Ready. Customer Invoice terbuka dengan baris Surat Jalan order itu; ubah Invoice menjadi Tidak untuk baris yang belum ditagih, lalu Create.

steps.en: For a Waiting row, ask Delivery to record the Proof of Delivery (Sales > Delivery > Proof of Delivery).
steps.id: Untuk baris Waiting, minta bagian Delivery mencatat Proof of Delivery (Sales > Delivery > Proof of Delivery).

fields.label: Oldest Delivery
fields.en: Date of the oldest delivery note of this order that is not fully invoiced.
fields.id: Tanggal Surat Jalan paling lama dari order ini yang belum habis ditagih.

fields.label: Ready to Invoice (value)
fields.en: Goods value of what the customer received and is not invoiced yet (quantity left x price, before document discount and VAT).
fields.id: Nilai barang yang sudah diterima customer dan belum ditagih (sisa qty x harga, sebelum diskon dokumen dan PPN).

fields.label: Waiting Proof of Delivery (value)
fields.en: Goods value of shipped lines whose proof of delivery is not recorded yet.
fields.id: Nilai barang baris yang sudah dikirim dan bukti terimanya belum dicatat.

fields.label: Status
fields.en: Ready to invoice when at least one line can be billed; otherwise Waiting proof of delivery.
fields.id: Ready to invoice bila minimal satu baris bisa ditagih; selain itu Waiting proof of delivery.

title: AR Aging

purpose.en: Unpaid confirmed customer invoices, with what is left to pay placed in an age column by days past the due date, as of today. Open it to see who owes how much and how late.
purpose.id: Invoice customer Confirmed yang belum lunas, dengan sisa tagihannya ditaruh di kolom umur menurut hari lewat jatuh tempo, per hari ini. Buka untuk melihat siapa berutang berapa dan seberapa terlambat.

keywords: ar aging, umur piutang, piutang, aging, jatuh tempo, lewat jatuh tempo, overdue, sisa tagihan, piutang customer, penagihan, collection

steps.en: Open AR Aging. Rows are grouped by Customer; each group header shows the totals of that customer.
steps.id: Buka AR Aging. Baris dikelompokkan per Customer; kepala tiap kelompok memuat total customer itu.

steps.en: Read the age columns: Not Due, 1-30 Days, 31-60 Days, 61-90 Days, Over 90 Days. The amount left of an invoice sits in exactly one of them.
steps.id: Baca kolom umur: Not Due, 1-30 Days, 31-60 Days, 61-90 Days, Over 90 Days. Sisa tagihan satu invoice berada di tepat satu kolom.

steps.en: Use the tabs above the list or the Age filter to see one age only, for example Over 90 Days.
steps.id: Pakai tab di atas daftar atau filter Age untuk melihat satu umur saja, misalnya Over 90 Days.

steps.en: Use Group to switch the grouping to Age, or Export to send the list to a spreadsheet.
steps.id: Pakai Group untuk mengganti pengelompokan menjadi Age, atau Export untuk mengirim daftar ke spreadsheet.

steps.en: To record a payment, open the invoice in Customer Invoice and click Record Payment.
steps.id: Untuk mencatat pembayaran, buka invoicenya di Customer Invoice lalu klik Record Payment.

fields.label: Days Overdue
fields.en: Days from the due date to today. 0 when the invoice is not due yet.
fields.id: Jumlah hari dari jatuh tempo sampai hari ini. 0 bila invoice belum jatuh tempo.

fields.label: Outstanding
fields.en: Invoice total minus down payment deducted, payments received and tax withheld.
fields.id: Total invoice dikurangi uang muka yang dipotong, pembayaran yang diterima, dan pajak yang dipotong.

fields.label: Age
fields.en: The age column the outstanding amount falls in.
fields.id: Kolom umur tempat sisa tagihan berada.

fields.label: Customer Order
fields.en: Hidden column (Columns button): the order the invoice bills.
fields.id: Kolom tersembunyi (tombol Columns): order yang ditagih invoice ini.

title: Down Payment Ledger

purpose.en: The history of every down payment, per Customer Order: invoiced, money received, deducted on which invoice, and what is left. Open it to answer "which order is this down payment for and where was it used".
purpose.id: Riwayat tiap uang muka, per Customer Order: ditagih, uang diterima, dipotong di invoice mana, dan sisanya. Buka untuk menjawab "uang muka ini untuk order yang mana dan dipakai di mana".

keywords: down payment ledger, buku uang muka, riwayat uang muka, uang muka, dp, sisa uang muka, dp outstanding, uang muka customer, uang muka per order, historical dp

steps.en: Open Down Payment Ledger. Each row is one event; rows are grouped by Customer Order.
steps.id: Buka Down Payment Ledger. Tiap baris adalah satu peristiwa; baris dikelompokkan per Customer Order.

steps.en: Events: Down payment invoiced (the request for payment), Money received (Record Receipt), Applied to invoice (deducted when an invoice of that order was confirmed).
steps.id: Peristiwa: Down payment invoiced (permintaan pembayaran), Money received (Record Receipt), Applied to invoice (dipotong saat invoice order itu di-Confirm).

steps.en: Read the group header: Money In minus Deducted = Balance, the money received and not deducted yet.
steps.id: Baca kepala kelompok: Money In dikurangi Deducted = Balance, yaitu uang yang sudah diterima dan belum dipotong.

steps.en: Document No. shows the bank receipt voucher or the invoice that used the down payment.
steps.id: Document No. memuat nomor bukti bank masuk atau invoice yang memakai uang muka itu.

steps.en: The same history is on the Down Payment Invoice (tab Down Payment History) and on the Customer Order (tab Billing).
steps.id: Riwayat yang sama ada di Down Payment Invoice (tab Down Payment History) dan di Customer Order (tab Billing).

fields.label: Billed
fields.en: Amount of the down payment invoice. Not a receivable and no journal until the money is received.
fields.id: Nilai tagihan uang muka. Bukan piutang dan belum ada jurnal sampai uangnya diterima.

fields.label: Money In
fields.en: Money received for the down payment.
fields.id: Uang yang diterima untuk uang muka itu.

fields.label: Deducted
fields.en: Part of the down payment deducted on an invoice.
fields.id: Bagian uang muka yang dipotong di sebuah invoice.

fields.label: Balance
fields.en: Money In minus Deducted. The total per order is the down payment still held for that order.
fields.id: Money In dikurangi Deducted. Total per order adalah uang muka yang masih dipegang untuk order itu.
